name: AlpacaEval
intro: AlpacaEval 使用来自Alpaca交互场景的805条指令，分别收集被测模型与基线模型回答，经顺序随机化后由自动裁判进行成对比较；长度控制版本再通过广义线性模型消除回答长度差异的影响并计算胜率。
build_method: Alpaca交互指令整理, 模型与基线成对生成, LLM自动裁判
task_type: 开放式对话, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 成对偏好, LLM-as-Judge, 顺序随机化, 长度去偏
build_method_en: Alpaca interaction instruction curation, evaluated and baseline response generation, automatic LLM judging
eval_feature_en: Pairwise preference, LLM-as-Judge, order randomization, length debiasing
intro_en: AlpacaEval uses 805 instructions representative of Alpaca interactions, collects responses from the evaluated and baseline models, randomizes their presentation order for pairwise automatic judging, and fits a generalized linear model to remove response-length effects for the length-controlled win rate.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2404.04475 and the official AlpacaEval package. The paper specifies 805 instructions representative of Alpaca web interactions, evaluated-model and GPT-4-Turbo baseline responses, randomized response ordering, GPT-4-Turbo pairwise preference estimates, and a generalized linear model that sets the response-length difference to zero when computing the length-controlled win rate.
